$comment: Every entry here is a hole in Headsmith's no-egress promise, so every entry
carries a reason and is reviewed as a change to a security file. See SECURITY.md.
`primitives` is empty and should stay empty: the bundle contains no fetch, XHR,
WebSocket, sendBeacon or EventSource at all. Vite's modulepreload polyfill was
the only one, and it is switched off in wxt.config.ts rather than excused here.
XML namespace URIs are identifiers, not locations. The browser passes them to
createElementNS to disambiguate element names and never dereferences them --
http://www.w3.org/2000/svg has never been fetched by any browser rendering an
<svg>. They are matched as exact prefixes rather than by host on purpose: an
allowlist entry for the host www.w3.org would also silently permit a genuine
<script src="https://www.w3.org/...">, which is the thing this guard exists

origins.reason: React's production build embeds the prefix "https://react.dev/errors/" so a minified invariant violation can be looked up by code. It is concatenated into a console message and never passed to a network API -- and with no network primitive left in the bundle there is nothing that could dereference it. Listed rather than patched out because removing it would mean forking react-dom for a string in an error path. Verified with: grep -o 'https://react.dev[^"]*' on the built chunk.
